name: Expanded Polynomial Inequality
description: Replaced the factored potential function with its fully expanded two-variable algebraic form, and changed the exact equality constraint (energy == 3m) to an inequality (energy <= 3m). This prevents the model from immediately factoring the expression to see it depends only on the difference between states, hiding the fact that the minimum is achieved exactly when states are distinct. The model is forced to treat it as a generic global optimization or constraint satisfaction problem, preventing the retrieval of degree-ordered graph coloring heuristics.
